source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, start the system and verify Power status On, then shut down the system and verify Power status Off.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES performs one assumed Redfish GET, disables TLS verification, exposes credentials through `-u`, conflates `.PowerState` with `.IndicatorLED`, does not use the required WebUI or create/correlate both on and off states, and incorrectly labels the service-impacting case no-risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly separates protected telemetry from approved host transitions, rejects IndicatorLED as power proof and requires validated resources, real WebUI evidence, stable-state polling, independent console truth and recovery.

old_problem: Items and detailed Procedure define WebUI Power status across On and Off, but the sole Criteria is an unrelated UID sentence. DeepSeek further collapses power and locator-indicator properties and replaces the two-state visual test with one unsafe API snapshot. The prior record correctly identified the defect but still required an engineer to restate an acceptance rule that can be derived from the dominant source intent and the standard schema.
disposition_reason: Use the unambiguous Items plus two explicit Procedure checkpoints as the authoritative review-layer intent: stable host On must display Power status On; after an approved graceful shutdown, stable host Off must display Power status Off. Preserve the incorrect UID Criteria verbatim as a source defect, do not claim UID coverage, and do not use IndicatorLED as a power oracle. Exact resources, UI field mapping, timing, transition method and final-state recovery remain Project parameters rather than an Engineering Decision Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 943, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 944 were directly reviewed; the next identity was verified as Functionality row 944 / variant 613366e7ad93cff4.

The title and both numbered Procedure steps repeatedly specify Power status On/Off, while the one-line UID Criteria names a different feature and provides no UID operation. The review-layer correction follows the dominant, executable source purpose without altering Master.

DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide defines chassis `PowerState` as actual resource power with stable `On`/`Off` and transient `PoweringOn`/`PoweringOff`, while `IndicatorLED` identifies the chassis. They are independent and cannot validate one another.
Actual WebUI presentation remains required; protected Redfish telemetry and independent console/OS evidence corroborate it but do not substitute for the visual UI checkpoint.

ED-06, ED-08, ED-20, ED-23, ED-29 and ED-33 through ED-38 require distinct transition semantics, complete OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready evidence where power is applied, visual correlation, no read-only substitution, recovery and engineer-owned DUT verdict.

test_case.test_name: Correlate BMC WebUI Power status with stable Off, On/OS-ready and graceful-shutdown-to-Off states
test_case.purpose: Verify that the actual BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs Power status field displays On only when the target host is stably powered and reaches OS Ready, and displays Off after an approved graceful shutdown reaches stable host Off, with Redfish and independent console evidence and no reliance on UID/IndicatorLED.
required_package: Exact BMC/SUT identity, firmware/WebUI build, trusted TLS chain, protected credentials and visual UI field/path mapping
Service-root-discovered Redfish ComputerSystem/Chassis resource URIs and schema mapping for actual PowerState; no assumed `/redfish/v1/Chassis/system`
Project definitions and bounded timeouts/poll intervals for stable Off, PoweringOn, On, OS Ready, graceful shutdown, PoweringOff and stable Off
Approved initial host-off state, maintenance window, workload/storage quiescence, supported DC/host power-on method and supported OS graceful-shutdown method
Independent KVM/console/host evidence, protected telemetry collector, SEL/BMC/OS/storage/device health baseline and out-of-band recovery path
Point-of-action approval for power-on and later graceful shutdown, plus the required final power state and any separately approved restoration to On
test_case.test_command: HIGH-IMPACT TWO-TRANSITION TEST; no action is authorized by this review. Preserve logs. First prove the correct target is in the approved stable host-Off state with no active workload or storage operation; this is host/DC state, not AC removal, cold cycle or reset. Capture the actual WebUI page visually and service-root-discovered Redfish plus independent console evidence; WebUI Power status and Redfish PowerState must be Off, while IndicatorLED/UID is recorded only as unrelated metadata. After approval 1, invoke only the approved host power-on method once, follow the ordered Off -> PoweringOn (if reported) -> On -> OS Ready timeline with bounded polling, and capture timestamped WebUI visual, Redfish and console/OS evidence. After health checks and approval 2, initiate the approved graceful OS shutdown once, follow OS shutdown -> PoweringOff (if reported) -> stable Off, and capture the same three evidence planes. Never use ForceOff, reset, AC/DC cycle substitution, `curl -k`, process-visible credentials or automatic retry. If Project final state is On, restore it only under a separately recorded recovery approval and prove OS/device health; do not count recovery as another test pass.
test_case.expected_result: In the initial stable Off state and final post-shutdown stable Off state, the actual WebUI Power status reads Off, authoritative Redfish PowerState is Off and console/host evidence confirms OS not running while BMC auxiliary power may remain. After approved power-on, the UI reads On only after Redfish reaches stable On and the same target reaches OS Ready with expected storage/devices. Transient, stale, Unknown/null and mismatched states never pass. UID/IndicatorLED is not used or claimed. Logs show only the approved power-on and graceful shutdown and no unapproved reset, hard-off or other target impact.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the complete ordered source matrix: stable Off evidence, one approved power-on through On and OS Ready, actual WebUI Power status On with API/console correlation, one approved graceful shutdown, and actual WebUI Power status Off with API/console correlation, plus final health/recovery proof. One snapshot, Redfish-only output, request success, ping, IndicatorLED/UID, transient PoweringOn/PoweringOff, or an assumed URI cannot pass. A wrong/stale/mismatched field, timeout, unapproved hard action, workload/storage impact or failed final-state recovery is FAIL and stops. Missing mappings/timing/maintenance values is NOT READY, not Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Verify immutable BMC/SUT identity, initial stable Off, workload/storage quiescence, console/recovery and maintenance approval before power-on; re-verify before graceful shutdown.
Obtain point-of-action approval for each transition and execute it once. No automatic retry, force off, reset, AC removal, DC-cycle substitution or escalation to a more disruptive action.
Use trusted TLS and protected credentials; do not use `curl -k`, expose secrets in arguments or assume a resource URI. Discover and record the authoritative resource and schema.
Preserve SEL, BMC, OS and storage evidence. Stop on stale/Unknown state, UI/API/console mismatch, unexpected reboot, device/storage error, wrong target or loss of independent recovery.
Require actual WebUI screenshots/video with target identity and timestamps for both stable states. API data supplements but never substitutes for the visual requirement.
Keep PowerState separate from UID/IndicatorLED. This case corrects an unrelated Criteria and does not assert locator-LED behavior or physical LED coverage.
expected_evidence: Approval, immutable target/BMC/WebUI/schema identity, service-root-discovered resources, trusted transport and initial workload/storage/host-Off baseline
Timestamped actual WebUI Power status visual plus complete Redfish PowerState/status and independent console evidence for initial stable Off
Ordered single power-on timeline through stable On and OS Ready, WebUI/API/console correlation, action audit and OS/storage/device health
Ordered single graceful-shutdown timeline through stable Off, WebUI/API/console correlation and preserved SEL/BMC/OS evidence
Final-state or separately approved restoration proof, no unapproved power action, explicit UID non-claim and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop immediately on timeout, wrong target, stale/mismatched telemetry, console loss or OS/storage/device fault and preserve all evidence. Maintain BMC plus independent console access; use the Project's approved recovery runbook and current observed state, never a blind reset, hard-off or repeated power request. If final Off is reached but the approved operational final state is On, obtain a separate recovery approval, power on once, wait through On to OS Ready and verify storage/devices before handoff.

source_conflict.reason: The repeated Items/Procedure power objective controls the Review-layer acceptance; the isolated UID sentence is preserved as an unrelated copied Criteria and explicitly excluded from claimed coverage. DMTF schemas confirm UID/IndicatorLED and PowerState are distinct.

blocked.reason: The two states, transition order and authoritative standard properties are defined. Exact UI/resource mappings, timing, maintenance window and recovery are finite Project readiness inputs.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide 2025.2
external_authorities.application: Defines Chassis PowerState On/Off and transient PoweringOn/PoweringOff, defines IndicatorLED as the chassis-identification LED, and defines GracefulShutdown separately from ForceOff and FullPowerCycle.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Data Model Specification 2025.3
external_authorities.application: Corroborates stable/transient power-state semantics and the separation of indicator state from actual resource power.

project_authority: The Project/vendor package binds the correct WebUI field, Redfish resources, transition methods, stable/OS-ready timing, initial/final states and recovery. It owns the DUT verdict; the Review layer resolves only the copied UID acceptance defect.
